text: {"overall_winner":"B","qualities":[{"evidence":"mostly complete multi-sentence paragraphs","quality":"organizational control","description":"The essay is arranged into clearer blocks of ideas that help the reader follow the line of reasoning more easily."},{"evidence":"linking words like \"however,\" \"most often,\" \"for example,\" and \"sometimes\"","quality":"transitions","description":"It uses more explicit connectors to show contrasts, examples, and progression between ideas."},{"evidence":"more developed general argument about hearing advice from multiple people","quality":"idea elaboration","description":"The essay expands its claim with repeated explanation and illustration rather than staying at a simple statement level."},{"evidence":"\"for example my friend's dad...\" and \"for example if I were to ask advice from my brother\"","quality":"supporting examples","description":"It includes more concrete examples to back up the main point and make the discussion feel more grounded."},{"evidence":"\"without you even knowing\" and \"that would impact him negatively\"","quality":"explanatory depth","description":"The essay more often explains effects and consequences, showing more control over developing an idea."}]}
